AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
